params.name: integration_id
params.description: WorkSpan integration ID identifying the target marketplace integration. Example: WS-Integration_ag1zfm1jYS1hcmp1bi00chULEgtJbnRlZ3JhdGlvbhiR7viJAQw

items.docs: Upload marketplace usage data for AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud marketplace integrations. Supports both JSON payload and CSV file uploads. Data is processed in batches and returns execution IDs for tracking. Payload structure varies by marketplace type - see definitions for AwsMarketplaceUsageUploadReq, AzureMarketplaceUsageUploadReq, or GoogleMarketplaceUsageUploadReq.
